sourceKind: Two operator raw tmux capture-pane -p -N -T ready/refusal captures are byte-identical. Ready snapshot retains all row lengths, positions, padding and final LF; row10/38 cwd, row15 prior prompt and row18 reply use equal-length synthetic replacements. Cursor36/2, modes and process/pane identity are reconstructed, not recorded in raw text files. Draft and guard are explicit hypothetical reconstructions: row36 new synthetic prompt, row39 warning-only footer, cursorX86, repeated stable draft. No post-paste or post-second-Enter raw capture exists; no second-ask acceptance is claimed. Operator reports persistence for 12 seconds and same process across Gateway restart/explicit reattach; not reproduced by coder.
